title: Enterprise Connectivity: customer cash refunds
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs customer cash refunds for cash refund.

## Policy clause 1
The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Policy clause 2
The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.

## Superseded scope 3
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for assisted overpayment payout. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

## Policy clause 4
A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced.

## Policy clause 5
Use refund rails, require at least minimum cash refund, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out.

## Policy clause 6
A smaller positive balance remains on account.

## Policy clause 7
Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure.

## Policy clause 8
Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund.

## Policy clause 9
A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Evidence condition 1
For cash refund, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, request reference, source-event reference, status, contract identifier. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier, request reference, source-event reference, contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Measurement basis
All posted financial events through the fixed current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, upward adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. The receivable is determined from those signed postings.

## Points of judgement
A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the refund rails, minimum cash refund, monetary decimal places, rounding convention used by this rule.

## Record identity: cash refund
A cash refund to the original payment destination reduces a customer overpayment. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch.

superseded_clauses: Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.
